content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Tron usdt

Selling digital products online can feel impossible if you're restricted by platforms that don't operate in your region. Traditional payment processors often charge excessive fees, taking a significant cut of your earnings. Tron USDT payments offer a solution: they provide a way to transact in cryptocurrency without the middlemen that impose steep fees. With NOWPayments, you can process payments at just 0.5%, allowing you to keep more of your earnings and ensuring you can reinvest in your creative endeavors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of this infrastructure involves a combination of tools and services that work seamlessly together. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing, you can create a robust online store without relying on traditional payment gateways. This architecture allows for automated product delivery and real-time crypto payment processing, ensuring that your customers receive their digital products instantly and securely.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators who are facing challenges with conventional payment systems. If you are in Nigeria, Ghana, or any other region where Stripe and PayPal do not operate, this architecture empowers you to take control of your digital commerce. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or templates, this system allows you to bypass the restrictions imposed by traditional platforms and build a sustainable income through digital sales.
Retain 100% of your earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each aspect of this infrastructure plays a pivotal role in the overall functionality of your digital commerce stack. Hosting platforms like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages provide a reliable and free way to display your products online. Meanwhile, backend solutions like Google Apps Script allow you to manage orders efficiently. Integrating NOWPayments ensures that you can easily accept Tron USDT and other cryptocurrencies, enabling instant transactions and direct payment verification. Together, they create a seamless experience for both you and your customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your digital store, begin by selecting your hosting provider, whether it's Cloudflare or GitHub Pages. Next, set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle your backend operations. Afterward, integrate NOWPayments for processing your cryptocurrency payments. Finally, ensure your products are loaded for sale, and promote your digital store. For a comprehensive setup, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to jumpstart your digital commerce operation.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a combination of free hosting solutions and cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This approach allows you to retain more profits by avoiding the high fees associated with traditional platforms. With NOWPayments charging only 0.5%, your earnings remain significantly higher compared to platforms with 10% fees.
Leverage cryptocurrency payments for instant transactions and delivery.

If you're looking to set up a digital download store that exclusively uses cryptocurrency, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to effectively sell your digital products. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
